question: In which form have earth forming materials been distributed?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Layers__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **earth-forming materials **have been distributed in the form of** layers** from the** crust to the core**.
 
• Earth is divided into** three layers** : **Crust** (outermost layer), **Mantle** (middle layer) and** Core** (inner most) and the Core is further divided into **outer core** and** inner core**.
 
• **Crust:**
 
 
• **​**The** outermost** layer of the Earth
 
• Composed of solid** rock and soil**
 
• Divided into **continental crust **and **oceanic crust**
 
• Thinnest layer, ranging from** 5 to 70 kilometers** thick
 
 
 
• **Mantle:**
 
 
• **​**Lies beneath the crust
 
• **Largest layer** of the Earth
 
• Made up of** **solid, but flowing rock called** magma**
 
• Extends from the** crust** to the** outer core**
 
 
 
• **Outer Core:**
 
 
• **​**Lies beneath the mantle
 
• Composed of** liquid iron** and** nickel**
 
• Surrounds the **solid inner core**
 
• Generates the **Earth's magnetic field** through convection currents
 
 
 
• **Inner Core:**
 
 
• **​**The** innermost** layer of the Earth
 
• Composed of** solid iron and nickel**
 
• Extremely hot, with temperatures reaching up to **5,700°C**
 
• Responsible for the **Earth's magnetic field and its stability**
